translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Eelihu Haasayee
Iyyoobi, «Taani s'illo asaa» geedda diraw, ha heezzu asatuu aw zaaruwaa immiyaawaa aggi basheeddino.
Iyyoobi S'oossaa s'illuwaa giyaawaa aggiide, barena s'illuwaa ootseedda diraw, Raama yara gidiyaa Buuziyaa Barkkeela na'ay Eelihu Iyyooba bolla loytsi hank'k'etteedda.
Eelihu k'ay Iyyooba heezzu laggetuwaakka hank'k'etteedda; ayaw gooppe, unttunttu Aa c'oo bayzzanchcha geeddinoppe attina, aw suure zaaruwaa zaaranaw danddayibeykkino.
Eelihu unttunttuppe teefatiyaa diraw, unttunttu ubbay haasayaa wurssana gakkanaw naageedda.
Ha heezzu asatuu Iyyoobaw gidiyaa zaaruwaa immanaw danddayibeennawaa be'iide, I loytsi hank'k'etteedda.
Buuziyaa Barkkeela na'ay Eelihu hawaadan yaagiide, haasayaa doommeedda; «Taani laytsan na'atay; hintte taappe c'imiita. Hewaa diraw, taani ta k'ofaa hinttew odanaw yayaad.
Taani, ‹C'imatuu haasayino; barenttu daro laytsan demmeedda aad'd'eeda eratetsaa tamaarissino› gaade k'oppaad.
Shin asaakko yiide, aad'd'eeda eratetsaa asaw immiyaawe Ubbaa Danddayiyaa S'oossaa Ayaanaa.
Asaa aad'd'eeda eranchcha kessiyaawe c'imatetsaa gidenna, woy likkebay geliyaawe daro de'eedda asatuwaassa gidenna.
Hewaa diraw, sisite; taanikka ta k'ofaa hinttew odana.
«Be'ite, hintte haasayiyaa wode, taani c'o"u gaade hayzzaad; hintte haasayana k'aalaa k'oppaade naagaad.
Taani hintte giyaawaa ubbaa wurssa sisaad; shin hintteppe ooninne Iyyoobi bayzzanchcha giide ammantsibeenna; k'ay hintteppe ooninne Aa palamaw bessiyaa zaaruwaa immibeenna.
Iyyooba haasayaw kalissiyaa zaaruwaa zaaranawe S'oossaappe attina, asaa gidenna diraw, hintte, ‹Nuuni aad'd'eeda eratetsaa demmeeddo› geenaadan naagettite.
Iyyoobi palumetteeddawe hinttenanappe attina, taananna gidenna. Taani hintte haasayeeddawaadan aw zaaruwaa immikke.
«Iyyoobaa, unttunttu dagammiide, ne haasayaw zaaruwaa immanaw danddayibeykkino; unttunttoo haasayiyaawe d'ayeedda.
Unttunttu haasayiyaawaa d'ayiide, c'o"u giide ek'k'ooppe, taanikka naaganaw koshshii?
Tawukka odiyaawe de'ee; taanikka ta k'ofaa odana.
Daro haasayiyaawe de'iyaa diraw, ta giddon de'iyaa ayyaanay taana oda giide giddee.
Be'ite, taw haasayiyaa kaalay imettennawaa gidooppe, taani ho"o woyniyaa eessay kumeedda ogoruwaadan d'uuk'k'ana hanay.
Taw hawaappe guutsaa keekkana mala, taani haasayanaw koshshee; ta doonaakka dooyaade, taani ta zaaruwaa immanaw koshshee.
Ha yewuwaan taani oonanne maaddikke, woy ay asanne c'oo sabbikke.
Ayaw gooppe, asaa c'oo sabbiyaawe taw mulekka erettenna. Taani k'ay hewaa hanooppe, taana Med'd'eeddawe taana murana.
